_readme: Unit data transcribed (OCR) from the official StarCraft TMG faction card sheets (Zerg v1.03.26, Terran v1.04.26, Protoss). Weapon keys: name, phase (ranged|melee), rng, target, roa, hit, dmg, surge (None|D3|D6), surge_plus (D3+1 -> 1), surge_tags (any listed tag triggers surge), anti_evade, precision, critical, pierce_x/pierce_tag, keywords (display only), upgrade (true = replaces/modifies a base weapon). Unit keys: tags, armour/evade (null = none), hp, shield, models_default/models_max, size, verify (note when the source was unclear). Weapon keywords that the calculator acts on: 'Burst Fire X" (N)' (checkbox, +N RoA per model), 'Long Range X"' (checkbox, -1 to hit) and 'Concentrated Fire (N)' (max N models destroyed, excess damage ignored). An attack option may add keywords with a top-level 'keywords' list (next to 'effects', not inside it). Edit or add units freely.
